title: High Court of Delhi
author: built-in
review: not reviewed: each quote was read in the Delhi High Court's e-filing rules and its practice direction No. 74/Rules/DHC on 2026-11-16; the advocate checks each list

sources.title: Practice directions: use of A4 size paper

locate.linkText: Use of A4 size paper uniformly

items.text: Paper size A4 (29.7 cm x 21 cm); margins 2 cm top and bottom, 4 cm left and right; justified.
items.quote: Paper size : A-4 (29.7 cm x 21 cm)

items.text: Font Times New Roman, size 14, line spacing 1.5; quotations and indents size 12 in single spacing.
items.quote: for quotations and indents font size 12 in single line spacing

items.text: Typed documents are converted into OCR-searchable PDF or PDF/A; PDF/A is preferred.
items.quote: converted into Optical Character Recognition (OCR) searchable Portable Document Format (PDF) or PDF/A

items.text: Documents that are not text are scanned at 300 DPI in OCR-searchable mode.
items.quote: scanned using an image resolution of 300 DPI (Dots per inch) in OCR searchable mode

items.text: The PDF is digitally signed by the party or the advocate (or e-Sign; else a signed print-out is scanned).
items.quote: The PDF document shall be digitally signed either by the parties and/or by their Advocate

items.text: Text and scanned documents are merged into one OCR-searchable PDF, bookmarked as per the Master Index.
items.quote: merged as a single OCR searchable PDF file and should be book-marked as per the Master Index

items.text: The e-file is at most 100 MB for the High Court; a larger file goes through a Designated Centre.
items.quote: maximum size of the e-file is fixed at 100 MB for the High Court

items.text: A4 paper of not less than 75 GSM is used for all pleadings, affidavits, applications and memoranda of appeal.
items.quote: A4 size paper (29.7 cm X 21 cm) having not less than 75 GSM

items.text: Printing is on one side of the paper.
items.quote: The printing / typing shall be on one side of the paper till further directions
